texts: The stones that pave the Cliff Path are flat and sea-worn.

fields.sentence: The stones that pave the Cliff Path are flat and sea-worn.

review.notes: Definite plural -> GroupOf plus the two per-member distribution rules matches the "The trellises are wooden" pattern, and "Cliff Path" gets the multi-word-name symbol with its kind atom and one Name. The restrictive relative is asserted as a group-level pave event (collective, no per-member rule), which is defensible for paving.
